sources.title: Consumer Acknowledgements and Publisher Confirms
supports: 发送者发布确认和消费者处理确认覆盖不同通信方向；发布确认不能证明后续业务已经完成
本片先可靠保存的前提是正确路由、持久消息与持久队列及发布确认配置；不能把任意confirm当作保存或业务成功
采用手动确认时，投递所在channel或connection关闭会使尚未确认的消息重新入队；发现断连需要时间
sources.sections: The Basics／Are Publisher Confirms Related to Consumer Delivery Acknowledgements?；Consumer Acknowledgement Modes；Automatic Requeueing；When Will Published Messages Be Confirmed by the Broker?

verification.method: Actual complete GET of official rabbitmq/rabbitmq-website sources at a fixed commit, then exact title/sentence and claim-context review. Canonical access results are recorded separately.

quotation.text: The two features, however, are entirely orthogonal and unaware of each other.

sources.title: Reliability Guide
supports: 消费者应在完成所需业务操作后再确认；确认意味着接收方承担该消息的责任
确认未到达会产生不确定性与重复投递风险；消息重来不意味着新订单或业务必然未完成，程序需按业务规则去重或幂等处理
消息安全需要发送者、broker及消费者共同负责，不能据有消息队列就声称exactly-once或永久不丢
sources.sections: Acknowledgements and Confirms；Data Safety on the Publisher Side；Data Safety on the Consumer Side
